limits: An owner must hold the key to remove an object; some accounts are lost or abandoned.
Some owners keep empty trust lines on purpose. This is the most that could come back, not money anyone forgot.

not_counted: tickets, escrows, channels, NFT pages, signer lists, AMM positions
method.note: Most object ids are uniform hashes, but NFTokenPage ids begin with the owner account id, so large NFT collections cluster; shard sizes differ, counts do not.
removable_rules: trust line side holding the reserve flag, holding 0 of the token, not deep-frozen (rippled TrustSet.cpp:501-514)
DEX offer, NFT offer or check whose Expiration <= ledger close time

title: State of the XRP Ledger: XRP held in removable objects
